item.name: Authentication

request.description:
Register a new user account.

**Chunk**: 05 - User Registration API Endpoint ✅
**Chunk**: 10 - Registration Page UI ✅

**Rate Limit**: 5 requests per 15 minutes

**Password Requirements**:
- Minimum 8 characters
- At least one uppercase letter
- At least one lowercase letter
- At least one number
- At least one special character

**Response**: Returns user data and JWT tokens (accessToken, refreshToken)

**Frontend UI**: Registration page available at `/register` with:
- Real-time password strength indicator
- Form validation with Zod schema
- Redux integration with registerUser thunk
- Auto-redirect to dashboard on success

Login with email and password.

item.name: Categories

query.description: Optional: Filter by category type (income, expense, both)

request.description:
Get all categories for the authenticated user.

**Chunk**: 15 - Category API Endpoints (CRUD) ✅

**Requires Authentication**: Yes (Bearer token)

**Query Parameters**:
- `type` (optional): Filter by category type - `income`, `expense`, or `both`
- `includeSubcategories` (optional): Include subcategories - `true` or `false` (default: `true`)

**Response**: Returns list of categories with total count

Create a new category for the authenticated user.

**Chunk**: 15 - Category API Endpoints (CRUD) ✅

**Requires Authentication**: Yes (Bearer token)

**Request Body**:
- `name` (required): Category name (1-100 characters)
- `type` (required): Category type - `income`, `expense`, or `both`
- `icon` (optional): Icon identifier (max 50 characters)
- `color` (optional): Hex color code (e.g., #FF5733 or #F73)
- `parentCategoryId` (optional): Parent category ID for subcategories
- `isDefault` (optional): Whether this is a default category

**Validation**:
- Prevents duplicate category names for same user + type
- Validates parent category exists and belongs to user
- Prevents circular references in category hierarchy

**Response**: Returns created category with 201 status

**Auto-Set Variables**:
- `categoryId` - Automatically set from the created category's `_id` field

Get a single category by ID.

**Chunk**: 15 - Category API Endpoints (CRUD) ✅

**Requires Authentication**: Yes (Bearer token)

**Path Parameters**:
- `id`: Category ID (MongoDB ObjectId)

**Response**: Returns category details

**Errors**:
- 404: Category not found
- 403: Category does not belong to user

Update a category by ID.

**Chunk**: 15 - Category API Endpoints (CRUD) ✅

**Requires Authentication**: Yes (Bearer token)

**Path Parameters**:
- `id`: Category ID (MongoDB ObjectId)

**Request Body** (all fields optional):
- `name`: Category name (1-100 characters)
- `type`: Category type - `income`, `expense`, or `both`
- `icon`: Icon identifier (max 50 characters)
- `color`: Hex color code
- `parentCategoryId`: Parent category ID (use `null` to remove parent)
- `isDefault`: Whether this is a default category

**Validation**:
- Validates ownership
- Prevents duplicate names when name/type changes
- Validates parent category if updated
- Prevents circular references

**Response**: Returns updated category

Delete a category by ID.

**Chunk**: 15 - Category API Endpoints (CRUD) ✅

**Requires Authentication**: Yes (Bearer token)

**Path Parameters**:
- `id`: Category ID (MongoDB ObjectId)

**Validation**:
- Validates ownership
- Prevents deletion if category has subcategories

**Response**: Returns success message with 200 status

**Errors**:
- 404: Category not found
- 403: Category does not belong to user
- 400: Category has subcategories (must delete or reassign subcategories first)

request.description:
Get all transactions for the authenticated user with filters and pagination.

**Chunk**: 20 - Transaction API Endpoints (CRUD) ✅

**Requires Authentication**: Yes (Bearer token)

**Query Parameters**:
- `type` (optional): Filter by transaction type - `income` or `expense`
- `categoryId` (optional): Filter by category ID
- `minAmount` (optional): Minimum amount filter
- `maxAmount` (optional): Maximum amount filter
- `startDate` (optional): Start date (ISO 8601 format)
- `endDate` (optional): End date (ISO 8601 format)
- `paymentMethod` (optional): Filter by payment method
- `tags` (optional): Comma-separated tags
- `search` (optional): Text search on description and tags
- `page` (optional): Page number (default: 1)
- `limit` (optional): Items per page (default: 20, max: 100)
- `sortBy` (optional): Sort field (default: `date`)
- `sortOrder` (optional): Sort order - `asc` or `desc` (default: `desc`)

**Response**: Returns list of transactions with pagination metadata

request.description:
Create a new transaction for the authenticated user.

**Chunk**: 20 - Transaction API Endpoints (CRUD) ✅

**Requires Authentication**: Yes (Bearer token)

**Request Body**:
- `type` (required): Transaction type - `income` or `expense`
- `amount` (required): Transaction amount (must be > 0, max: 999,999,999.99)
- `currency` (required): 3-character ISO currency code (e.g., USD, EUR)
- `categoryId` (required): Category ID (MongoDB ObjectId)
- `description` (optional): Transaction description (max 1000 characters)
- `date` (required): Transaction date (ISO 8601 format or Date object)
- `paymentMethod` (optional): Payment method - `cash`, `card`, `bank_transfer`, `digital_wallet`, `other`
- `tags` (optional): Array of tags (max 20 tags, each max 50 characters)
- `location` (optional): Location object with `latitude`, `longitude`, `address`
- `receiptId` (optional): Receipt ID (MongoDB ObjectId)
- `isRecurring` (optional): Whether transaction is recurring
- `recurringPattern` (optional): Recurring pattern object with `frequency`, `endDate`, `nextOccurrence`

**Validation**:
- Validates category exists and belongs to user
- Validates category type matches transaction type
- Validates recurring pattern if isRecurring is true

**Response**: Returns created transaction with 201 status

**Auto-Set Variables**:
- `transactionId` - Automatically set from the created transaction's `_id` field

request.description:
Get transaction statistics for the authenticated user.

**Chunk**: 21 - Transaction Redux Slice (Enhanced) ✅

**Requires Authentication**: Yes (Bearer token)

**Query Parameters**:
- `startDate` (optional): Start date for filtering (ISO 8601 format)
- `endDate` (optional): End date for filtering (ISO 8601 format)

**Response**: Returns transaction statistics including:
- `income`: { total, count, average, min, max }
- `expense`: { total, count, average, min, max }
- `net`: Net amount (income - expense)
- `totalTransactions`: Total number of transactions

**Errors**:
- 400: Invalid date format or date range

Create multiple transactions at once.

**Chunk**: 21 - Transaction Redux Slice (Enhanced) ✅

**Requires Authentication**: Yes (Bearer token)

**Request Body**:
- `transactions` (required): Array of transaction objects (1-100 transactions)
  - Each transaction follows the same schema as single transaction creation
  - All fields are validated individually

**Validation**:
- Validates each transaction individually
- Returns detailed errors for failed transactions
- Continues processing even if some transactions fail

**Response**: Returns:
- `transactions`: Array of successfully created transactions
- `successCount`: Number of successfully created transactions
- `failedCount`: Number of failed transactions
- `failedTransactions`: Array of failed transactions with error details (if any)

**Limits**:
- Maximum 100 transactions per request

**Errors**:
- 400: Validation errors (all or some transactions invalid)
- 500: Server error (if all transactions fail)

item.description:
Transaction management endpoints for CRUD operations, statistics, and bulk operations

**Chunk 22 - Transaction List UI Component** ✅
The TransactionList component uses these endpoints:
- GET /api/v1/transactions - For displaying transactions with filters, pagination, and sorting
- GET /api/v1/transactions/stats - For transaction statistics (used in dashboard)
- POST /api/v1/transactions/bulk - For bulk transaction creation

All filtering, sorting, and pagination features in the UI are powered by the query parameters supported by these endpoints.

**Chunk 23 - Transaction Form UI Component** ✅
The TransactionForm component uses these endpoints:
- POST /api/v1/transactions - For creating new transactions (all fields supported: type, amount, currency, category, date, description, paymentMethod, tags, location, receiptId, isRecurring, recurringPattern)
- PUT /api/v1/transactions/:id - For updating existing transactions
- GET /api/v1/categories - For loading categories filtered by transaction type

The form includes comprehensive validation, draft saving, and supports both create and edit modes.

**Chunk 24 - Transactions Page with Full CRUD** ✅
The transactions pages integrate all CRUD operations:
- GET /api/v1/transactions - Used by /transactions page (list view)
- POST /api/v1/transactions - Used by /transactions page (create modal)
- GET /api/v1/transactions/:id - Used by /transactions page (fetch transaction for editing)
- PUT /api/v1/transactions/:id - Used by /transactions page (update modal)
- DELETE /api/v1/transactions/:id - Used by /transactions page (delete with confirmation)

All operations use modals (not standalone routes), with toast notifications for success/error feedback and automatic list refresh after operations.

item.name: Dashboard

request.description:
Get dashboard summary data for the authenticated user.

**Chunk**: 26 - Dashboard Overview with Summary Cards ✅

**Requires Authentication**: Yes (Bearer token)

**Response**: Returns comprehensive dashboard summary including:
- `totalIncome`: Total income across all time
- `totalExpense`: Total expenses across all time
- `balance`: Net balance (income - expense)
- `currency`: User's preferred currency
- `thisMonth`: Monthly statistics (income, expense, net)
- `totalTransactions`: Total number of transactions
- `incomeCount`: Number of income transactions
- `expenseCount`: Number of expense transactions
- `recentTransactions`: Array of last 5 transactions with details

**Frontend UI**: Dashboard page available at `/dashboard` with:
- 4 summary cards (Total Balance, Total Income, Total Expenses, This Month)
- Recent transactions list (last 5)
- Quick actions section
- Auto-refresh on page visibility/focus
- Loading states and error handling

**Data Updates**: Dashboard automatically refreshes when:
- Page loads
- User navigates back to the tab (visibility change)
- Window gains focus
- User manually refreshes the page
